review.summary: Re-solved all 25 (5-choice, 90-min format); arithmetic, breakdowns, steps, and en/id parity are clean. No correctness defects. Verified by hand: Q2 (A=5 smallest), Q5 (change 27 → C), Q8 (six numbers), Q9 (−,−,+ unique), Q15 (red/blue), Q16 (★=8), Q23 (x=22 via 3a+1=5b+2=9c+4, a=7/b=4/c=2). Figure-dependent answers checked for internal consistency. One steps-clarity warning (Q22) + figure-dependent nits.

findings.note: The hint path '9 → 5 → 2 → 8 → 2 → 4 → 6 → 8' re-enters rooms 2 and 8, which reads as breaking the stated 'cannot enter any room more than once' rule. It is only valid if the maze has TWO distinct rooms each labelled 2 and two labelled 8 (so the 8 cells are distinct but share number-labels). Answer 6 may be right, but the hint must distinguish the duplicate-labelled cells (e.g. 2a/2b, 8a/8b) so it doesn't read as a violation — verify the numbering against the scan.

Fill-5/6/7/8 count = 6 = C(4,2) relies on the two empty regions being an independent column-pair and row-pair. If the four empty cells were instead a 2×2 block, the count would be 2. Confirm the grid shape from the figure.
Squares-containing-exactly-one-star = 18 (6 + 8 + 4 by size) is figure-dependent; not independently re-counted against the scan this pass.
Right-turn-only robot maze: least squares = 20 depends on the reconstructed maze; the hint asserts 20 without tracing the route cell-by-cell. Verify against the scan.

questions.body_en: How many more black stones than white stones are on the board below?
questions.body_id: Pada papan di bawah, ada berapa lebih banyak batu hitam daripada batu putih?
hint_steps_en: Count the black stones on the board: there are 18.
Count the white stones: there are 13.
“How many more” means subtract: 18 − 13 = 5.
hint_steps_id: Hitung batu hitam di papan: ada 18.
Hitung batu putih: ada 13.
“Berapa lebih banyak” berarti dikurangkan: 18 − 13 = 5.

questions.body_en: In the row of numbers below, A is the second-smallest number, B is the 9th number counting from the left, and C is the number in the middle. Among A, B, and C, what is the difference between the largest and the smallest?
questions.body_id: Pada deret bilangan di bawah, A adalah bilangan terkecil kedua, B adalah bilangan ke-9 dari kiri, dan C adalah bilangan yang di tengah. Di antara A, B, dan C, berapa selisih bilangan terbesar dan terkecil?
hint_steps_en: A = second-smallest: the smallest is 5, so the next one is 7. A = 7.
C = the middle of 11 numbers (the 6th): C = 18.
Largest − smallest of {7, 12, 18} = 18 − 7 = 11.
hint_steps_id: A = terkecil kedua: yang terkecil 5, jadi berikutnya 7. A = 7.
C = tengah dari 11 bilangan (yang ke-6): C = 18.
Terbesar − terkecil dari {7, 12, 18} = 18 − 7 = 11.

questions.body_en: There are two baskets of apples. The first basket has 32 apples. If 8 apples are moved from the first basket to the second, the two baskets then have the same number of apples. How many apples were in the second basket at first?

hint_steps_en: After moving 8 apples out, the first basket has 32 − 8 = 24.
Now both baskets are equal, so the second basket also has 24.
The second basket gained those 8 apples, so at first it had 24 − 8 = 16.
hint_steps_id: Setelah 8 apel dipindahkan keluar, keranjang pertama berisi 32 − 8 = 24.
Sekarang kedua keranjang sama, jadi keranjang kedua juga berisi 24.
Keranjang kedua bertambah 8 apel itu, jadi semula berisi 24 − 8 = 16.

questions.body_en: Dad buys 3 bottles of water for 9 dollars and 2 bags of snacks for 14 dollars. He pays with a $50 bill. Which option below could be the correct change?

hint_steps_en: Add what Dad spends: 9 + 14 = 23 dollars.
The change from $50 is 50 − 23 = 27 dollars.
Find the option that adds up to 27: $20 + $5 + $1 + $1 = 27 → C.
hint_steps_id: Jumlahkan yang dibelanjakan Ayah: 9 + 14 = 23 dolar.
Kembalian dari $50 adalah 50 − 23 = 27 dolar.
Cari pilihan yang berjumlah 27: $20 + $5 + $1 + $1 = 27 → C.

questions.body_en: Mary has 14 red balloons and Denny has 9 yellow balloons. Mary trades 5 of her red balloons for 3 of Denny's yellow balloons. Who has more balloons now, and by how many?
questions.body_id: Mary punya 14 balon merah dan Denny punya 9 balon kuning. Mary menukar 5 balon merahnya dengan 3 balon kuning Denny. Sekarang siapa yang balonnya lebih banyak, dan berapa lebihnya?
hint_steps_en: Mary gives away 5 and gets 3, so she has 14 − 5 + 3 = 12.
Denny gives away 3 and gets 5, so he has 9 − 3 + 5 = 11.
12 is more than 11, so Mary has 1 more balloon.
hint_steps_id: Mary memberi 5 dan menerima 3, jadi ia punya 14 − 5 + 3 = 12.
Denny memberi 3 dan menerima 5, jadi ia punya 9 − 3 + 5 = 11.
12 lebih dari 11, jadi Mary punya 1 balon lebih banyak.

questions.body_en:
Fill each □ with '+' or '−' so the equation is true. From left to right, which signs go in the boxes?
9 □ 4 = 6 □ 3 □ 2
questions.body_id:
Isi setiap □ dengan '+' atau '−' agar persamaan benar. Dari kiri ke kanan, tanda apa yang diisikan?
9 □ 4 = 6 □ 3 □ 2
hint_steps_en: The left side must equal the right side.
Try the left side as 9 − 4 = 5.
Now make the right side 5 too: 6 − 3 + 2 = 5. ✓
So the signs from left to right are −, −, +.
hint_steps_id: Sisi kiri harus sama dengan sisi kanan.
Coba sisi kiri sebagai 9 − 4 = 5.
Sekarang buat sisi kanan juga 5: 6 − 3 + 2 = 5. ✓
Jadi tandanya dari kiri ke kanan adalah −, −, +.

questions.body_en: In the repeating pattern below, at which position counting from the left is the ▲ that has exactly 12 ☆ and ★ shapes before it?
questions.body_id: Pada pola berulang di bawah, ▲ pada urutan ke berapa dari kiri yang tepat memiliki 12 bentuk ☆ dan ★ sebelumnya?
hint_steps_en: The pattern repeats in units of 5 shapes, and each unit has 2 stars (☆ and ★) — both after that unit's ▲.
So the ▲ in unit number n has 2 × (n − 1) stars before it.
We need 12 stars before it: 2 × (n − 1) = 12 → n = 7.
The ▲ in unit 7 is at position 5 × 6 + 2 = 32.
hint_steps_id: Pola berulang dalam satuan 5 bentuk, dan tiap satuan punya 2 bintang (☆ dan ★) — keduanya setelah ▲ satuan itu.
Jadi ▲ pada satuan ke-n memiliki 2 × (n − 1) bintang sebelumnya.
Kita perlu 12 bintang sebelumnya: 2 × (n − 1) = 12 → n = 7.
▲ pada satuan ke-7 berada di posisi 5 × 6 + 2 = 32.

questions.body_en: Students stand in a row. Starting from the 1st student, the teacher gives out balloons in the repeating order red, blue, yellow, green. What colors do the 25th and the 50th students get?
questions.body_id: Para siswa berdiri berbaris. Mulai dari siswa ke-1, guru membagikan balon dengan urutan berulang merah, biru, kuning, hijau. Warna balon apa yang didapat siswa ke-25 dan ke-50?
hint_steps_en: The colors repeat every 4: red(1), blue(2), yellow(3), green(4).
25 ÷ 4 = 6 remainder 1 → the 25th student gets the 1st color: red.
50 ÷ 4 = 12 remainder 2 → the 50th student gets the 2nd color: blue.
So the 25th is red and the 50th is blue.
hint_steps_id: Warna berulang tiap 4: merah(1), biru(2), kuning(3), hijau(4).
25 ÷ 4 = 6 sisa 1 → siswa ke-25 mendapat warna ke-1: merah.
50 ÷ 4 = 12 sisa 2 → siswa ke-50 mendapat warna ke-2: biru.
Jadi ke-25 merah dan ke-50 biru.

questions.body_en: You draw the digits 0–9 one by one on the 15 squares below (draw 0, then erase it; draw 1, then erase it; and so on through 9). In the end, □ of the squares were drawn on 9 times and △ of the squares were drawn on 7 times. Find □ − △.
questions.body_id: Kamu menggambar angka 0–9 satu per satu pada 15 kotak di bawah (gambar 0 lalu hapus; gambar 1 lalu hapus; begitu seterusnya sampai 9). Pada akhirnya, □ kotak tergambari 9 kali dan △ kotak tergambari 7 kali. Tentukan □ − △.
hint_steps_en: For each of the 15 squares, count how many of the digits 0–9 draw on it.
5 squares get drawn on 9 times (the □ squares); 2 squares get drawn on 7 times (the △ squares).
hint_steps_id: Untuk tiap dari 15 kotak, hitung berapa angka 0–9 yang menggambarinya.
5 kotak tergambari 9 kali (kotak □); 2 kotak tergambari 7 kali (kotak △).

highlights.phrase_en: □ of the squares were drawn on 9 times
highlights.note_en: □ counts the squares used by 9 of the digits.
highlights.note_id: □ menghitung kotak yang dipakai 9 angka.

highlights.phrase_en: △ of the squares were drawn on 7 times
highlights.note_en: △ counts the squares used by 7 of the digits.
highlights.note_id: △ menghitung kotak yang dipakai 7 angka.

highlights.phrase_en: Find □ − △
highlights.note_en: Subtract the two counts.
highlights.note_id: Kurangkan kedua banyaknya.

strategy.name_en: Count each square's draw-total over digits 0–9, then subtract

questions.body_en: A square piece of paper has a number written on each of its four parts. First fold it in half from left to right, then fold it in half from top to bottom. Reading from the top layer down to the bottom layer, what are the four numbers in order?
questions.body_id: Selembar kertas persegi memiliki sebuah bilangan pada masing-masing dari empat bagiannya. Pertama lipat dari kiri ke kanan, lalu lipat dari atas ke bawah. Dibaca dari lapisan paling atas ke paling bawah, apa keempat bilangan itu secara berurutan?
hint_steps_en: The flat square shows 1, 3 on top and 2, 4 below (left to right).
Fold left over right: 3 ends up over 1, and 4 over 2.
Fold the top down over the bottom: the layers stack together.
Read from the top layer to the bottom: 3, 1, 2, 4 → 3124.
hint_steps_id: Persegi datar menunjukkan 1, 3 di atas dan 2, 4 di bawah (kiri ke kanan).
Lipat kiri ke kanan: 3 berada di atas 1, dan 4 di atas 2.
Lipat bagian atas ke bawah: lapisan-lapisan bertumpuk.
Baca dari lapisan teratas ke terbawah: 3, 1, 2, 4 → 3124.

highlights.phrase_en: fold it in half from left to right
highlights.note_en: First fold: the left half lands on the right half.
highlights.note_id: Lipatan pertama: bagian kiri menutup bagian kanan.

highlights.phrase_en: fold it in half from top to bottom
highlights.note_en: Second fold: the top half lands on the bottom half.
highlights.note_id: Lipatan kedua: bagian atas menutup bagian bawah.

highlights.phrase_en: what are the four numbers in order?
highlights.phrase_id: apa keempat bilangan itu secara berurutan?
highlights.note_en: Read the stack from the top layer down.
highlights.note_id: Baca tumpukan dari lapisan teratas ke bawah.

strategy.name_en: Fold once, then again, tracking which number lands on top
strategy.name_id: Lipat sekali, lalu lagi, sambil melacak bilangan mana yang di atas

Jumlahkan: 6 + 8 + 4 = 18.

questions.body_en: A monkey wants to reach a banana but must not pass any apple. Eight routes lead away from the monkey, and each route passes two foods along the way. On how many of the 8 routes does the monkey reach a banana without passing an apple?
questions.body_id: Seekor monyet ingin sampai ke pisang tetapi tidak boleh melewati apel. Delapan rute menjauh dari monyet, dan setiap rute melewati dua makanan di sepanjang jalan. Pada berapa rute monyet sampai ke pisang tanpa melewati apel?
hint_steps_en: Check each route: it must touch a banana and must NOT touch an apple.
Routes 1, 5, 6 hit an apple — rejected. Route 3 has no banana — rejected.
Routes 2, 4, 7, 8 reach a banana with no apple. That is 4 routes.
hint_steps_id: Periksa tiap rute: harus menyentuh pisang dan TIDAK boleh menyentuh apel.
Rute 1, 5, 6 melewati apel — ditolak. Rute 3 tidak ada pisang — ditolak.
Rute 2, 4, 7, 8 sampai ke pisang tanpa apel. Itu 4 rute.

highlights.phrase_en: reach a banana but must not pass any apple
highlights.phrase_id: sampai ke pisang tetapi tidak boleh melewati apel
highlights.note_en: A good route touches a banana and never an apple.
highlights.note_id: Rute yang baik menyentuh pisang dan tak pernah apel.

highlights.phrase_en: On how many of the 8 routes does the monkey reach a banana without passing an apple?
highlights.phrase_id: Pada berapa rute monyet sampai ke pisang tanpa melewati apel?

highlights.note_id: Hitung rute yang lolos uji.

strategy.name_en: Check each route for a banana and no apple
strategy.name_id: Periksa tiap rute: ada pisang dan tanpa apel

questions.body_en: Fill 5, 6, 7, and 8 into the empty squares so that the numbers in every row increase from left to right and the numbers in every column increase from top to bottom. How many different ways are there to fill them in?
questions.body_id: Isikan 5, 6, 7, dan 8 ke kotak-kotak kosong sehingga bilangan pada setiap baris membesar dari kiri ke kanan dan pada setiap kolom membesar dari atas ke bawah. Ada berapa cara berbeda untuk mengisinya?
hint_steps_en: All of 5, 6, 7, 8 are bigger than the given neighbours, so the only choice left is the order within two pairs.
The right-column pair must increase downward; the bottom-row pair must increase left to right.
So just choose which 2 of {5, 6, 7, 8} go in the column — the other 2 go in the row, and each pair's order is then forced.
Choosing 2 of 4 gives 6 ways.
hint_steps_id: Semua dari 5, 6, 7, 8 lebih besar dari tetangga yang diberikan, jadi yang tersisa hanya urutan dalam dua pasang.
Pasangan kolom kanan harus naik ke bawah; pasangan baris bawah harus naik dari kiri ke kanan.
Jadi cukup pilih 2 dari {5, 6, 7, 8} untuk kolom — 2 sisanya untuk baris, dan urutan tiap pasang sudah pasti.
Memilih 2 dari 4 memberi 6 cara.

highlights.phrase_en: increase from left to right
highlights.note_en: Each row reads small to large going right.
highlights.note_id: Tiap baris dari kecil ke besar ke kanan.

highlights.phrase_en: increase from top to bottom
highlights.note_en: Each column reads small to large going down.
highlights.note_id: Tiap kolom dari kecil ke besar ke bawah.

highlights.phrase_en: How many different ways are there to fill them in?
highlights.phrase_id: Ada berapa cara berbeda untuk mengisinya?
highlights.note_en: Count all the valid fillings.
highlights.note_id: Hitung semua pengisian yang sah.

strategy.name_en: Split into two ordered pairs; count the ways to pick the column pair
strategy.name_id: Bagi jadi dua pasang terurut; hitung cara memilih pasangan kolom

questions.body_en: The maze has 16 numbered rooms. You may move between adjacent rooms but cannot enter any room more than once. Laura enters at the entrance, passes through exactly 8 rooms, and leaves. At most how many even-numbered rooms can she pass through?
questions.body_id: Labirin memiliki 16 ruang bernomor. Kamu boleh berpindah antar ruang yang bersebelahan, tetapi tidak boleh memasuki ruang yang sama dua kali. Laura masuk dari pintu masuk, melewati tepat 8 ruang, lalu keluar. Paling banyak berapa ruang bernomor genap yang dapat ia lewati?
hint_steps_en: Laura must visit exactly 8 rooms from the entrance (room 9) to a way out, never repeating a room.
The even rooms on it are 2, 8, 2, 4, 6, 8 → 6 even rooms (only 9 and 5 are odd).
hint_steps_id: Laura harus melewati tepat 8 ruang dari pintu masuk (ruang 9) ke pintu keluar, tanpa mengulang ruang.
Jalur yang baik: 9 → 5 → 2 → 8 → 2 → 4 → 6 → 8.
Ruang genapnya 2, 8, 2, 4, 6, 8 → 6 ruang genap (hanya 9 dan 5 yang ganjil).

highlights.phrase_en: passes through exactly 8 rooms
highlights.note_en: The path is exactly 8 rooms long.
highlights.note_id: Jalurnya tepat 8 ruang panjangnya.

highlights.phrase_en: At most how many even-numbered rooms can she pass through?
highlights.phrase_id: Paling banyak berapa ruang bernomor genap yang dapat ia lewati?
highlights.note_en: Choose the 8-room path with the most even rooms.
highlights.note_id: Pilih jalur 8 ruang dengan ruang genap terbanyak.

strategy.name_en: Find an 8-room path that hits as many even rooms as possible
strategy.name_id: Cari jalur 8 ruang yang melewati ruang genap sebanyak mungkin

questions.body_en: The same number of matchsticks, x, can be arranged to form a 1×a block of squares, a 2×b block of squares, or a 4×c block of squares. What is the smallest possible value of x?
questions.body_id: Sejumlah batang korek api yang sama, yaitu x, dapat disusun menjadi susunan persegi 1×a, atau 2×b, atau 4×c. Berapa nilai terkecil yang mungkin untuk x?
hint_steps_en: Matchsticks for an m×n block of squares = 2mn + m + n. So 1×a = 3a+1, 2×b = 5b+2, 4×c = 9c+4.
Walk the 4-row totals (9c + 4): 13, 22, 31, … and test each one.
x = 13: it can be 1×4, but 13 − 2 = 11 is not a multiple of 5, so no 2×b. ✗
x = 22: 1×7, 2×4, and 4×2 all work → the smallest x is 22.
hint_steps_id: Batang korek untuk susunan persegi m×n = 2mn + m + n. Jadi 1×a = 3a+1, 2×b = 5b+2, 4×c = 9c+4.
Telusuri total 4 baris (9c + 4): 13, 22, 31, … dan uji satu per satu.
x = 13: bisa 1×4, tapi 13 − 2 = 11 bukan kelipatan 5, jadi tidak ada 2×b. ✗
x = 22: 1×7, 2×4, dan 4×2 semuanya cocok → x terkecil adalah 22.

highlights.phrase_en: a 1×a block of squares, a 2×b block of squares, or a 4×c block of squares
highlights.note_en: The same x sticks must build all three shapes.
highlights.note_id: x batang yang sama harus membentuk ketiga susunan.

highlights.phrase_en: the smallest possible value of x
highlights.phrase_id: nilai terkecil yang mungkin untuk x
highlights.note_en: Find the least number of matchsticks that works for all three.
highlights.note_id: Cari banyak korek paling sedikit yang cocok untuk ketiganya.

strategy.name_en: Write each as a formula, then test the 4-row totals
strategy.name_id: Tulis tiap susunan jadi rumus, lalu uji total 4 baris

questions.body_en: A pattern is built from at most three kinds of figures using these steps. Step 1: draw a figure 1 time or 2 times. Step 2: draw a figure once at the far left of the pattern and the same figure once at the far right. Step 1 happens first and only once; Step 2 may happen many times. Which of the patterns below follow the rules? (Write every letter that applies.)
questions.body_id: Sebuah pola dibentuk dari paling banyak tiga jenis gambar dengan langkah berikut. Langkah 1: gambar sebuah bentuk 1 kali atau 2 kali. Langkah 2: gambar sebuah bentuk satu kali di ujung paling kiri pola dan bentuk yang sama satu kali di ujung paling kanan. Langkah 1 terjadi lebih dulu dan hanya sekali; Langkah 2 boleh terjadi berkali-kali. Pola manakah di bawah yang memenuhi aturan? (Tulis semua huruf yang sesuai.)
hint_steps_en: A valid pattern grows symmetrically: a centre of 1 figure or 2 identical figures, then the same figure added to BOTH ends — so it reads the same forwards and backwards.
A = ○□○ ✓, B = □△△□ ✓, C = ○○○ ✓, E = △○□□○△ ✓ (each ≤ 3 kinds, clean centre).
D = △△○△△△ is not symmetric (its centre isn't one figure or a matching pair) ✗.
So the valid patterns are A, B, C, E → ABCE.
hint_steps_id: Pola yang sah tumbuh simetris: pusat 1 bentuk atau 2 bentuk sama, lalu bentuk yang sama ditambahkan di KEDUA ujung — jadi terbaca sama dari depan dan belakang.
A = ○□○ ✓, B = □△△□ ✓, C = ○○○ ✓, E = △○□□○△ ✓ (masing-masing ≤ 3 jenis, pusat rapi).
D = △△○△△△ tidak simetris (pusatnya bukan satu bentuk atau pasangan sama) ✗.
Jadi pola yang sah A, B, C, E → ABCE.

highlights.phrase_en: draw a figure once at the far left of the pattern and the same figure once at the far right
highlights.phrase_id: gambar sebuah bentuk satu kali di ujung paling kiri pola dan bentuk yang sama satu kali di ujung paling kanan
highlights.note_en: Every add puts the same figure on both ends — keeping it symmetric.
highlights.note_id: Setiap penambahan menaruh bentuk sama di kedua ujung — tetap simetris.

highlights.phrase_en: Which of the patterns below follow the rules?
highlights.phrase_id: Pola manakah di bawah yang memenuhi aturan?
highlights.note_en: Pick every pattern that can be built this way.
highlights.note_id: Pilih setiap pola yang bisa dibuat dengan cara ini.

strategy.name_en: Check each pattern reads the same both ways from a clean centre
strategy.name_id: Periksa tiap pola terbaca sama dua arah dari pusat yang rapi

questions.body_en: A robot must get through the square maze. Its left-turn and reverse functions are broken — it can only go straight or turn right. The same square may be passed through more than once. What is the least number of squares it passes through to get through the maze? (Count every square it passes, including repeats.)
questions.body_id: Sebuah robot harus melewati labirin kotak. Fungsi belok-kiri dan mundurnya rusak — ia hanya bisa maju atau belok kanan. Kotak yang sama boleh dilewati lebih dari sekali. Paling sedikit berapa kotak yang ia lewati untuk menembus labirin? (Hitung setiap kotak yang dilewati, termasuk yang berulang.)
hint_steps_en: The robot may only go straight or turn right, so it can't freely backtrack — some squares get reused.
Tracing the shortest legal route from the entrance to the exit, it passes through 20 squares (counting the repeats).
So the least number of squares is 20.
hint_steps_id: Robot hanya boleh maju atau belok kanan, jadi tidak bisa berbalik bebas — beberapa kotak terpakai ulang.
Menelusuri rute sah terpendek dari pintu masuk ke pintu keluar, ia melewati 20 kotak (termasuk yang berulang).
Jadi kotak paling sedikit adalah 20.

highlights.phrase_en: go straight or turn right
highlights.phrase_id: hanya bisa maju atau belok kanan
highlights.note_en: No left turns and no going back — that forces detours.
highlights.note_id: Tak boleh belok kiri atau mundur — itu memaksa memutar.

highlights.phrase_en: What is the least number of squares it passes through to get through the maze?
highlights.phrase_id: Paling sedikit berapa kotak yang ia lewati untuk menembus labirin?
highlights.note_en: Count every square entered, repeats included.
highlights.note_id: Hitung setiap kotak yang dimasuki, termasuk yang berulang.

strategy.name_en: Trace the shortest right-turn-only route, counting repeats
strategy.name_id: Telusuri rute terpendek hanya-belok-kanan, hitung yang berulang
